messages:
kari: Follow-up from the postmortem: we need a one-page safety checklist for rollouts that infra can enforce. Key pieces: containment window, clear auto-actions (quarantine/degrade/rollback), blast-radius caps, recurrence fingerprinting, and owners with timelines.

diego: +1. Proposal: two enforcement modes: soft-fallback (reduce sample / pin) and hard-rollback. Soft first for low-severity; hard if signature is severe.

nora: Define signatures precisely. My take: three signals: error_rate_mult (5m), p99_mult (5m), probe_quality_drop (small eval). 2/3 -> quarantine+fallback; 3/3 -> immediate rollback.

samir: Also enforce per-flag emergency_cap_pct (runtime-enforced default 1%) and max_sample_pct. Runtime must never exceed emergency cap unless an approver lifts it.

kari: Draft gating snippet (for RFC) that we'll store as gating_config_id on deploys: 

```json
{"gating_config_id":"g-2265-01","flag":"chat-reply-v1","phases":["0.5%","5%","25%","100%"],"phase_timeout_mins":60,"containment_window_mins":12,"emergency_cap_pct":1,"max_sample_pct":10,"signatures":{"error_mult":3.0,"p99_mult":2.0,"probe_drop_pct":2.0},"auto_sequence":["quarantine","fallback_pin","rollback"],"fingerprint_fields":["flag","variant","signature_id"]}
```

diego: Runtime behaviors: quarantine pins most traffic to previous variant and routes a small fraction with doubled probe sampling. fallback_pin holds for containment_window and then either heal or escalate to rollback.

nora: Telemetry needed: counters `guard.quarantine`, `guard.fallback`, `guard.rollback`; gauge `guard.quarantine_time`; event `guard.fingerprint` containing `sha256(flag|variant|signature_id)` so analytics can group recurrence.

samir: Ownership and dates:
- kari: write RFC + canonical gating examples (3 business days)
- diego: runtime hooks for emergency_cap + fallback_pin (2 weeks)
- nora: probe-set + eval integration + baseline snapshots (7 days)
- samir: recurrence dashboard + weekly dedup job + calendar automation (3 weeks)

ops-bot: REMINDER: PRs that change rollout defaults must include `./ci/rollout_smoke.sh` and attach `deployment.gating_config_id` to deploy audits. Merge blocked without smoke success.

kari: Small UX: add `hold_until_approval` option so teams can opt into manual promotions. Emit `guard.hold_approved` when human approves.

diego: Add telemetry counters for operator actions (`guard.manual_rollback`, `guard.hold_approved`) so we can measure human interventions.

nora: For recurrence detection: weekly job groups guard.fingerprint over 90 days and auto-open review tasks if a fingerprint appears >1 time. Escalate if repeats without mitigation.

kari: I'll file RFC + tickets and tag owners. If no objections I'll set due dates.

diego: ACK. starting runtime branch tomorrow.

nora: ACK. will prepare probe eval and snapshots.

samir: ACK. will draft dashboard mockups.

kari: Thanks all ")
